warning_source: Ronen Bar, Director of the Shin Bet
recipient: National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir
warning_summary: Bar urged Ben Gvir not to visit the Temple Mount during Sukkot, warning that the timing could inflame/exacerbate security tensions and presenting security ramifications and intelligence.
evidence_state: Contemporaneous Channel 13 reporting was carried on 4 Oct by ICE/Israel National News and on 5 Oct by Times of Israel. Ben Gvir's response corroborated the security-assessment discussion and reporting interpreted him as agreeing to postpone. Published to Notion as Medium / Contemporaneous / Strongly documented receipt / Moderately specific.
gaps: Exact call date is not public; no recording, minutes or intelligence document has been released. This is an escalation-risk warning, not a Hamas invasion prediction.

warning_source: Brig. Gen. Amit Saar, head of IDF Military Intelligence Research Division
recipient: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu; National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir; security-cabinet participants
warning_summary: In the 28 Jan security cabinet, Saar warned that Ben Gvir's Temple Mount policy was encouraging attacks in the West Bank.
evidence_state: Zman Israel/Haaretz reporting on 28 Apr 2025 described review of the full contemporaneous cabinet protocol. Published to Notion as Medium / Both / Strongly documented receipt / Moderately specific.
gaps: Complete cabinet protocol is not publicly linked. The same reported protocol says Saar assessed Gaza as restrained; this event must not be represented as a Hamas-Gaza invasion warning. Specific government response remains unclear.

warning_source: Maj. Gen. Aharon Haliva, IDF Military Intelligence chief
warning_summary: Haliva reportedly told Netanyahu 'we are in an accessibility drought in Gaza,' meaning Israeli intelligence coverage of Gaza was insufficient, while MI was trying to repair failing collection/access projects.
evidence_state: Ynet investigation published 28 Feb 2025 reproduces the warning and says Netanyahu agreed on the importance of the information and need to improve coverage.
gaps: Exact meeting date/forum is not yet established from the public article and independent primary/official corroboration has not been recovered. Hold below acceptance pending protocol/meeting identification or corroboration.

warning_source: Ronen Bar, Director of the Shin Bet
recipient: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu; National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir; senior security officials in Ramadan-preparation discussion
warning_summary: Bar reportedly warned in a February Ramadan-preparation meeting that Israel was 'on the way to escalation.' Netanyahu responded that Israel had no interest in a Ramadan flare-up and called for precise offensive actions alongside de-escalatory measures.
evidence_state: Ynet investigation published 28 Feb 2025 reproduces detailed meeting content and Netanyahu's response.
gaps: Exact meeting date and an independently corroborating protocol/official record were not recovered. Retrospective investigative reporting alone is insufficient for promotion under the corroboration rule.
